Ad Sales Specialist 는 쿠팡에 입점해 광고를 진행 중인 중소형 규모의 업체를 배정받아, 장기적인 관점에서 광고를 컨설팅하고 비즈니스 성장 비전을 제시합니다. 담당 셀러를 대상으로 광고를 성공적으로 운영하기 위한 최적 설정을 점검하고 카테고리와 마켓 트렌드, 시즈널리티, 매출 트렌드 등 깊이 있는 지표를 기반으로 쿠팡에서의 성장 방향성을 제안합니다. 또한 쿠팡의 광고가 판매자의 비즈니스 성장의 디딤돌이 될 수 있도록 광고주의 현재 매출 규모와 목적에 따라 가장 적합한 광고 상품을 제안하고 분석하여 탄탄한 성장을 이끌어내는 목표 지향적 광고 비즈니스를 이끌어 갑니다.

광고, 플랫폼, 이커머스 비즈니스의 영업 전문가로서 커리어를 개발할 수 있으며, 지표 툴과 생산성 관리 툴 활용, 체계적인 교육과 세일즈 플레이북을 토대로 훌륭한 영업 전문가로서 성장할 수 있는 기틀을 마련할 수 있는 기회입니다.

업무 내용

• 쿠팡에 입점되어 있는 다양한 카테고리의 중소 규모 광고주들과의 지속적인 파트너십을 유지하고 광고 투자를 확대할 수 있는 광고 영업 활동 수행
• 다수 광고주의 계정을 전략적으로 관리하며 우선순위를 설정하고 광고주 성장 지원
• 광고주들이 광고의 올바른 활용과 효율적인 투자를 통해 쿠팡에서의 비즈니스를 성공할 수 있도록 컨설팅 하고 비전 제시
• 광고 상품의 효과를 기반으로 광고주의 운영 방식 개선 및 성과 극대화
• 시즈널리티에 따른 비즈니스 변화를 빠르게 포착하고, 프로덕트 업데이트 사이클에 맞춰 공격적이고 적극적인 영업을 통해 쿠팡과 광고주 모두 비즈니스 기회를 최대화할 수 있도록 기여
• 쿠팡에서 축적 및 분석하는 방대하고 깊이 있는 데이터를 마스터하여 광고주의 투자성과 분석을 지원하고, 데이터에 기반한 가치 제안
• 광고주와의 신뢰 관계를 통해 피드백을 수집하고 광고 서비스 개선

jobs.description: Overview This role is part of the North America Beverage organization and supports the Commercial team by delivering business-critical reporting, analytics, and actionable insights across Channels, Brands, Customers, and Sales Areas. The position is responsible for developing and maintaining Power BI reporting solutions, managing data acquisition and validation, analyzing complex datasets, and translating data into meaningful insights that enable data-driven decision-making for Sales Leadership across Sector and Division teams. As the primary and only dedicated analytics resource supporting the West OTS team, this is a business-critical role responsible for ensuring the timely delivery of day-to-day reporting, operational analytics, and ad hoc business requests. The role also drives continuous improvement through reporting modernization, automation, and the adoption of advanced analytics, helping enhance business performance, improve operational efficiency, and support key commercial initiatives. Responsibilities Support the Commercial function with performance reporting against established KPIs, including ad hoc reporting using internal, shipment/POS, and market data (IRI). Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and scorecards that improve accessibility, visualization, and business agility. Leverage Power BI and Data Bricks (must-have) and other analytical tools and techniques to deliver reporting, advanced analytics, and actionable business insights. Collate, validate, and analyze large, complex datasets across multiple channels, customers, brands, and sales areas to identify performance trends and opportunities. Present clear, concise insights and recommendations to Sales Leadership to support data-driven decision-making. Analyze innovation and portfolio performance to identify opportunities across Channels, Brands, Customers, and Markets. Support field sales execution through timely reporting and compliance analytics. Partner with cross-functional teams to perform root cause analysis and deliver actionable business insights. Build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders through clear verbal and written communication. Ensure the accurate and timely delivery of reporting and analytics in accordance with agreed service level agreements (SLAs), while maintaining a strong focus on quality and execution. Contribute to the modernization of reporting solutions by leveraging Power BI best practices, automation, and scalable reporting frameworks. Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve reporting efficiency through innovative analytics solutions. Support the adoption of AI-driven insights, predictive analytics, and emerging technologies to enhance business decision-making. Drive continuous improvement by simplifying processes, standardizing reporting, optimizing technology, and identifying opportunities to enhance service delivery. Foster an inclusive and collaborative work environment. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, Marketing, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field. A Master's degree is a plus. 6 - 7 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Reporting, Data Analytics, Sales Analytics, or a related analytical role. Prior experience in the Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) industry is preferred. Strong hands-on experience with Power BI (required), including report/dashboard development, data modeling, DAX, and Power Query. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with SQL is preferred. Knowledge of Python, R, or other analytical tools is an added advantage. Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail. Ability to analyze complex datasets and translate findings into actionable business insights and recommendations. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively present insights to business stakeholders and leadership. Strong stakeholder management and customer service orientation, with the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams. Excellent time management, prioritization, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple deliverables in a fast-paced environment. Demonstrated ability and willingness to learn new technologies, business processes, and PepsiCo systems.

Come build the AI platform that lets developers everywhere go from idea to production. You'll lead high-impact programs at the heart of how customers train, customize, and run AI models at massive scale.

We're looking for a hands-on program leader who thrives in ambiguity and loves turning big, messy problems into clear plans that ship. In this role you'll:

Own the strategy and end-to-end delivery of cross-cutting programs that span multiple engineering and product teams
Drive alignment across organizations, making the hard trade-offs and keeping everyone moving toward the same goal
Build repeatable processes and automation that help teams move faster and with higher quality
Partner with engineering, product, and science teams to turn customer pain points into roadmap priorities

If you're energized by the frontier, high ownership, and the chance to shape how the world builds with AI, we'd love to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities
Own the strategy and end-to-end delivery of cross-cutting programs that span multiple engineering, product, and science teams
Build and own long-term roadmaps that improve delivery speed, quality, and operational excellence across our services
Identify trends across programs and influence prioritization so teams invest in the highest-impact work

Design repeatable processes, standards, and automation that help teams scale without slowing down

A day in the life
Your day starts with a pulse check on the programs you own. You'll scan where things stand, spot the risks that are about to become problems, and decide where your attention will make the biggest difference. The customers you're ultimately serving are the builders who use these AI services every day. 회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는
여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
조직 소개
Rocket Growth(RG)는 쿠팡의 풀필먼트 기반 비즈니스로, 셀러가 고객에게 최상의 배송 및 구매 후 경험을 제공할 수 있도록 지원합니다. RG를 통해 셀러의 상품은 로켓 배지를 획득하고, 쿠팡의 로켓 배송 네트워크를 통해 빠르게 배송됩니다. RG는 쿠팡 내 가장 빠르게 성장하고 있는 조직 중 하나이며, 다양한 신규 제품과 기능 출시 로드맵을 가지고 있습니다.
현재 저희는 정책 프로그램 및 거버넌스를 리드할 Principal Program Manager를 채용하고 있으며, RG 정책이 명확하게 정의되고, 효과적으로 운영되며, 일관되게 적용될 수 있도록 함으로써 셀러 행동을 유도하고, 운영 효율성과 고객 신뢰를 강화하는 역할을 맡게 됩니다. 이 역할에서는 정책 프로그램의 기획부터 실행, 적용, 개선까지 End-to-End 전체 라이프사이클을 직접 리딩하게 됩니다.
또한 Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Operations 등 다양한 조직과 협업하며 비즈니스 요구사항을 확장 가능한 정책 실행 체계로 구현하는 역할을 수행합니다.
주요 업무
1) 정책 프로그램 총괄 (Policy Program Ownership)

기존 정책의 문제점 및 공백을 분석하고, 비즈니스 목표에 맞는 개선안 제안

정책의 기획부터 롤아웃까지 End-to-End 실행 리드

정책 거버넌스 체계 구축 및 운영

모든 셀러 및 케이스에서 일관성 유지
Legal 및 Compliance 조직과 협업하여 정책의 규제 및 내부 기준 충족 보장

셀러 대상 정책 가이드 및 교육 자료 제작
정책의 명확성, 접근성, 투명성 향상
셀러의 정책 이해도 및 준수율 개선

Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Ops 간 중심 조정 역할 수행
정책 우선순위, 트레이드오프, 실행 방향 정렬

주요 KPI 정의 및 모니터링
정책 준수율
셀러 위반 및 제재 상황
비즈니스 영향 (상품 다양성, 품질, 고객 경험 등)

정책과 정산 프로세스 간 정합성 확보
정책 기반 수수료 적용 및 운영

We’ve made incredible scientific breakthroughs and our pioneering personalized CAR T-cell therapies have changed the paradigm. But we're not finished yet.

Join Kite, as we make even bigger advances in cancer therapies, and help shape where our business and medical science goes next.

As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Kite and help create more tomorrows.

Job Description

As Enterprise Technology Lead, Senior Manager, you will provide strategic and technical leadership for Kite’s cell order management and supply chain technology landscape, while serving as a trusted technology partner to business stakeholders. You will translate business priorities into scalable, reliable, and compliant technology solutions, champion cross-functional collaboration, and ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value while supporting regulatory compliance and operational excellence.

Lead a team of onshore and offshore functional/technical analysts. Establish the support model and performance management with the system integration partner, manage resource allocations, define technical standards, and be the primary point of escalation.

This role will serve as the local technical lead for critical incidents affecting patient treatment, supply chain logistics, chain of custody/identify, labeling support issues, and other time-sensitive operations.

This is an exciting opportunity to join one of the global leaders in cell therapy. We need colleagues interested in change, in challenge and in building a new future together.

Kite, A Gilead Company

At Kite, we are at the forefront of immunotherapy and engineered T cell therapy. We are helping change the paradigm of cancer treatment and are revolutionizing individually tailored treatments. That means a fast moving and constantly changing environment, where we make discoveries every day – discoveries that include our own capabilities and individual potential. We’re seeking to recruit highly motivated talent to join our exciting mission, in the development of innovative cell therapies and their application to the treatment of patients with cancer.

The Team

You will be an integral and highly visible part of Kite’s global IT team. Your efforts will support the definition of a global IT strategy and accompanying roadmap for Kite’s mission of treating and curing cancer with cell therapy.

Essential Duties and Job Functions

General responsibilities for this position will include (but are not limited to) the following:

• Build trusted relationships with leaders and stakeholders across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Logistics, Quality, and Patient Operations; understand their priorities and translate business needs into technology strategies, roadmaps, and executable solutions.
• Lead cross-functional alignment across business, IT, vendors, and support organizations by facilitating decisions, clarifying priorities and trade-offs, and driving issues through resolution to achieve successful business outcomes.
• Serve as the technical authority for Kite Konnect Enterprise and Supply Chain architecture, integrations, APIs, customizations, interfaces, and data management solutions, ensuring designs are scalable, supportable, reliable, and aligned with Gilead architecture standards.
• Own the Kite Konnect Enterprise and Supply Chain IT business capability roadmap in partnership with business stakeholders, balancing operational needs, compliance requirements, technical modernization, and strategic growth initiatives.Oversee Kite Konnect Enterprise and Supply Chain IT release planning, SDLC governance, environment management, deployment readiness, testing strategies, change management, patching, upgrades, and rollback procedures to ensure safe and effective delivery of system changes.
• Own the health, stability, performance, and operational resilience of Kite Konnect Enterprise and Supply Chain platforms and integrations, including incident response, root cause analysis, corrective actions, service metrics, monitoring, and support governance.
• Lead integration and data-related activities across Oracle EBS, SAP, Salesforce, and downstream applications, including reliability, error handling, interoperability, data quality, migration, reconciliation, and master data governance.
• Provide directions to managed service providers, implementation partners, and support teams; manage priorities, backlog, resource planning, service delivery performance, SLAs, and partner accountability.
• Communicate system health, risks, incidents, project status, recommendations, and operational trends to leadership, business partners, vendors, and cross-functional teams.

• Master's Degree and 8+ years of relevant experience in IT OR
• Bachelor's Degree and 12+ years relevant experience in IT

Knowledge, Experience and Skills

• 10+ years of experience supporting ERP platforms, including Oracle E-Business Suite, SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, and related applications.
• 5+ years of experience leading digital operations, technical delivery, production support, or managed service teams in a complex global environment.
• Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders, develop a strong understanding of operational priorities, and influence technology decisions as a strategic advisor.
• Strong business acumen and the ability to connect technology strategy, architecture, and delivery decisions to operational outcomes, patient impact, risk reduction, and measurable business value.
• Strong understanding of end-to-end supply chain, manufacturing, logistics, finance, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, inventory, warehouse management, and related life sciences business processes.
• Hands-on experience with migration, integration, and application delivery across platforms such as: Oracle EBS, SAP, Salesforce, Veeva, Sitecore, and downstream related systems.
• Strong technical knowledge of middleware platforms, APIs, web services, event-driven integrations, integration patterns, data transformation, reconciliation, data quality, and master data management.
• Experience with digital operations and support governance, including incident and problem management, ITIL service management, monitoring, operational reporting, root cause analysis, corrective actions, change and release management, environment management, and risk mitigation.
• Proven ability to lead solution design reviews, establish technical standards, oversee SDLC delivery, manage third-party vendors and global delivery partners, and drive outcomes in a matrixed organization.
• Strong systems thinking, analytical problem-solving, communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, influencing, project/portfolio management, ownership, accountability, and operational rigor.
• Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on operational execution, manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment, and communicate complex technology considerations, risks, options, and recommendations in clear business terms across technical, operational, and executive audiences.
• Significant relevant experience in commercial life science, pharmaceutical, or similarly regulated environment preferred; occasional travel to Kite/Gilead locations may be required.

Behaviors

• Resilient with the ability to perform in an ambiguous environment and under pressure.
• Ability to engage and manage multiple stakeholders – at all levels – to achieve objectives.

• Consultative and collaborative, with the ability to listen, challenge constructively, build alignment, and influence outcomes without direct authority.

• Versatile - with the ability to deliver against a broad set of objectives and competing priorities concurrently.
• Consistent excellence in both planning and execution.
• Organized and disciplined with a systematic approach to problem solving.
• Honest and credible.

jobs.description: Job Description The Role: At General Motors, the Vehicle Motion Controls and Estimation (VMCC) Platform Design team develops reusable vehicle-motion control and estimation solutions for future vehicle platforms. This role provides technical leadership in either the steering-controls domain or the suspension and vertical-motion-controls domain, depending on the position. The steering focus includes electric power steering (EPS), steer-by-wire, and active rear steering. The suspension focus includes semi-active and active suspension and vertical vehicle motion. In either focus area, you will own the technical domain while helping develop a scalable VMCC platform that supports multiple vehicle configurations, actuator technologies, operating modes, and driver modes. This role is designed for an experienced automotive controls engineer from a leading OEM or Tier 1 supplier who can lead work from vehicle-dynamics analysis through control- architecture and algorithm design and into production software, calibration, and vehicle validation. What You’ll do: Lead end-to-end controls design for either the steering or suspension/vertical-motion domain. Develop reusable control and estimation algorithms that translate vehicle-level motion objectives into actuator commands while accounting for system constraints, operating modes, and degraded operation. For steering-focused positions, develop controls for EPS, steer-by-wire, and active rear steering, including steering response, driver feedback, desired-state and trajectory tracking, disturbance rejection, mode transitions, and fault-tolerant or degraded operation. For suspension-focused positions, develop controls for adaptive and active suspension, including ride, handling, body-motion, wheel-motion, roll, pitch, and heave objectives. Define platform interfaces, control ownership, actuator coordination, arbitration, and technology-specific extensions that scale across vehicle configurations. Develop vehicle-motion state estimators, observers, sensor-processing and sensor-fusion methods, system-identification approaches, and parameter-estimation techniques that support robust controls performance. Coordinate with braking, propulsion, rear-steering, and other chassis domains to deliver cohesive vehicle-motion behavior. Translate vehicle-dynamics, ride, handling, stability, comfort, and controllability objectives into control requirements, performance metrics, algorithms, and calibration strategies. Use model-based development, vehicle-dynamics simulation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), driver-in-the-loop (DiL), and in-vehicle testing to design, calibrate, verify, and validate controls. Implement algorithms in production-oriented embedded software and support requirements development, interface definition, design reviews, diagnostics, and software-release activities. Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, resolve cross-functional issues, and communicate design decisions across controls, software, systems, calibration, test, and program teams Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications) MSc or PhD in Controls, Robotics, Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering or equivalent degree with relevant experience. 5+ year of relevant experience Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Demonstrated ability to deliver clear technical reports and presentations. Excellent collaboration and communication skills. Valid driver’s license for occasional test support. What Will Give You A Competitive Edge (Preferred Skills) Experience writing and understanding software/hardware requirements and interfaces, with exposure to tools such as DOORS, DNG, JAMA, or equivalent. Familiarity with automotive product release and specification processes. Knowledge of related automotive systems (powertrain, driveline, CAN/LIN networks). Experience with advanced test setups (dSPACE HiL, DiL) and/or in-vehicle track testing. This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the selected candidate is expected to report to a specific location at least 3 times a week {or other frequency dictated by their manager}.
